# Acorny Documentation
# https://docs.acorny.io/llms.txt

## About Acorny
Acorny is a Readwise alternative that helps readers capture highlights from books, articles, PDFs, and supported reading tools, migrate existing highlights, then review important ideas with recall cards and spaced repetition.

## Core Concepts
- Highlights: Text selections or notes saved from reading.
- Sources: Books, articles, PDFs, feeds, or files that highlights came from.
- Recall cards: Review prompts generated from highlights so readers practice remembering ideas.
- Spaced repetition: A scheduling method that shows material again after increasing intervals when it is remembered and sooner when it is difficult.
- Import: A one-time transfer from an export file or supported import screen.
- Sync: An ongoing connection or reader app setup that keeps sending new highlights after initial setup.

## Supported Sources
Kindle, Readwise, Koodo Reader, Moon+ Reader, Readest, WeRead, Instapaper, Inoreader, Cubox, Diigo, PDF, CSV, and Acorny export files.

## Support and Safety
Do not include passwords, API tokens, session cookies, or private keys when asking for help. Use the support page to share source names, file formats, timestamps, and screenshots with sensitive values hidden.
